Case note: R.C.A. No. 1954/2025
Client: Deepak Trivedi (architect, New Delhi)
Opposing party: Ravi Karve
Court: New Delhi District Court
Filed on: 5 August 2025
Claim amount: INR 3,80,000/-
Issue: tenancy eviction. The landlord needs the premises for the family's own use.
Advice given: Plead bona fide personal need with proof of the family's housing requirement.
Outcome: The eviction was granted on the ground of personal need.
Recommended next step: Give the tenant time to vacate under the decree.
Witness: Yogesh Subramanian
